personalInfo.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | Applied AI & Enterprise Systems

summary: Senior full-stack engineer with 12+ years of experience delivering enterprise applications, retail systems, and AI-enabled software. Hands-on across React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, and Flutter, from user interfaces and APIs to offline synchronization, cloud deployment, and device integration. Recent projects combine AI-assisted sales calling, lead management, speech transcription, and speaker diarization. Based in Dubai and open to senior full-stack and applied AI opportunities.

experience.description: Developed retail ERP modules spanning POS, queue management, IoT automation, and AI vision for multi-branch operations. Built offline-first queue management using Flutter, Node.js, Hive synchronization, MQTT events, and branch dashboards. Integrated YOLO-based self-checkout detection with Android AIDL hardware control and LED/GPIO feedback. Designed MySQL-Hive synchronization and WireGuard connectivity for distributed store systems.
